name: Francisco Assis - Après le § 1 - Am 14
title: REPORT on the financial activities of the European Investment Bank – annual report 2024
part_text: 1a. Takes note of the adoption of the EIB Group Action Plan on Security and Defence and calls on the EIB to continue supporting dual-use projects in line with trusted civil use principles; highlights the importance of support instruments for SMEs in the defence industry and for innovation, especially via simplified procedures and technical assistance;
